packageRules.description: Keep the .NET 10 Microsoft.Extensions entries on v10; the separate .NET 11 entries already use v11.
Workflow dotnet-version inputs install supported target runtimes; global.json owns SDK upgrades.
net10.0 pins of packages released with .NET stay on 10.x; the net11.0 pins in Directory.Packages.props take the next major.
Dependency updates use the repository's draft review lifecycle, overriding inherited automerge rules.
